articles.title: Waddling Through the Shallows: Divers Discover a New Walking Shark in Papua New Guinea
articles.summary: A shark that strolls across the seafloor? Divers in Papua New Guinea just discovered a new species of walking shark, named Hemiscyllium dudgeonae, with a unique pattern of brown dots and white dashes. It's the 10th known walking shark, and it thrives in water less than 3 feet deep.

articles.title: Olivia Rodrigo Launches All-Women Daisy Chain Fields Festival to Benefit Charities
articles.summary: Olivia Rodrigo is turning her dream into reality with Daisy Chain Fields, an all-women music festival on Aug. 29 in Irvine, Calif. The lineup includes Chappell Roan, KATSEYE, Doechii, and Stevie Nicks, with 100% of net proceeds going to organizations that advance women and girls.

articles.title: From Rebel T-Shirts to TikTok: How Teenagers Have Been Reinventing Pop Culture for Decades
articles.summary: The concept of the 'teenager' was an accidental 20th-century invention, but it sparked a cultural revolution. With disposable income, cars, and their own hangouts, each generation of teens has reshaped music, fashion, and communication—from drive-ins to smartphones.
